select a.id as id, a.userId as userId, a.postTextContent as postTextContent, a.postImageUrl as postImageUrl, a.postVideoUrl as postVideoUrl, a.openness as openness, a.viewer as viewer, a.lng as lng, a.lat as lat, a.viewNum as viewNum, a.favoriteNum as favoriteNum, a.likeNum as likeNum, a.commentNum as commentNum, a.shareNum as shareNum, a.remark as remark, a.createTime as createTime, a.updateTime as updateTime,
(select count(*) from SnsPostLike l where l.postId = a.id and l.likeUserId = #{viewerUserId} )>0 as isLike,
0 as isLike,
(select count(*) from SnsFollow l where l.followedUserId = a.userId and l.userId = #{viewerUserId} )>0 as isFollow,
0 as isFollow,
(select count(*) from SnsFriend l where l.friendUserId = a.userId and l.userId = #{viewerUserId} )>0 as isFriend,
0 as isFriend,
b.accountName as accountName, b.headUrl as headUrl from SnsPost a,Account b where a.userId=b.userId and a.openness = 1 and a.userId in (select followedUserId from SnsFollow where userId = #{viewerUserId}) and ( viewer = 0
or (viewer = 1 and (select count(*) from SnsFollowFans c where c.followedUserId = a.userId and c.followerUserId = #{viewerUserId})>0 )
or (viewer = 2 and (select count(*) from SnsFriend c where c.userId = a.userId and c.friendUserId = #{viewerUserId})>0 )
)
AND a.userId = #{userId}
AND a.postTextContent LIKE CONCAT('%',#{postTextContent}, '%')
order by a.createTime desc
